header: Run onboarding yourself, or bring in our team
subheadline: Most teams build their first journey the same afternoon they sign up. Others are moving 200 live accounts off a spreadsheet and want someone who has done it before sitting next to them. Both routes start on the same platform.
left_description: Start on Starter at EUR 39 per seat, pick one of 40 journey templates and invite your first customer the same day. Fourteen days free, no card.
right_description: A four-week guided migration: we map your current process, rebuild it as templates and train your managers. Included on Scale, EUR 2,400 one-off on other plans.
